answer: New agents earn full rights only through a tenure lantern that brightens with time, not money. First, each newcomer lights a lantern by locking 200 POA as a quartz bond and posting weekly heartbeat proofs for ninety days. Second, it dims fast: three missed heartbeats or one proven lie slashes the bond and resets tenure to zero. Third, only lanterns burning bright for ninety days win full trading rights. Forging ten thousand fakes would lock $4 million in bonds and burn 900,000 waiting days, over $6 million in lost yield. Like a willow, trust bends in the wind, but only deep roots hold.
